title: Quietly Simmered Italian Fennel Ribollita
description: A winey and tender Italian dish featuring fennel, perfect for a cozy evening, this vegetarian-friendly ribollita is a hearty and comforting meal. It is made with a variety of vegetables and beans, simmered in a rich and flavorful broth.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped fennel and carrots and cook until they begin to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the canned diced tomatoes, cannellini beans, vegetable broth, and red wine, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Season the ribollita with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the ribollita hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or thyme, if desired.
Let the ribollita rest for 10 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
